comment: He is SO intelligent in his field, and if you get a chance talk to him about what else he does besides teach, his life is very interesting. He gives very good feedback on papers and is always willing to hear you out. If you're a good writer he'll love you. He's often really funny too

This dude is the bomb. At first I was like, what's this skinny white dude teaching a rap music class for? But he's so thug and is very smart. Discussion based class. Homework is reading and online discussion blogs. Assignments are innovative and essays are interesting. Great dude, love him. TAKE HIM if you can, but expect to work, not an easy A!
